title: Drupalcon: D7 Advanced Form API Session! | RandyFay.com
primaryHeading: Drupalcon: D7 Advanced Form API Session!
lines: Alex Bronstein, (effulgentsia) one of the maintainers of the Form API, will be doing an off-Broadway session on D7 Advanced Form API tomorrow (Wednesday) at 4:15pm in room 252. This is an exciting chance to catch up on all the great simplifications (and changes) in D7 FAPI.
The essential $form_state keys (and the ones that are gone now)
And much, much more, of course
Check out the slides in advance
If you care about the Form API, BE THERE!
